Seat, couchette or sleeper? What you get for the price

By Jonas Ferreira · Updated October 2026

Night trains sell three kinds of places. Here is what each one costs and what you get for it.

A reclining seat is the cheapest option, from €39, but few people sleep well in one.

A bed in a six-berth couchette starts at €69. You share the compartment and get a pillow, a blanket and a sheet.

A private sleeper compartment starts at €159 for one or two people and includes a washbasin and breakfast.
